notes: This fixes the reported same-module case, but cross-module precedence is still decided per ConfigResource: when a parent imports one instance, every child-module import for other instances of that resource (or other module instances) is silently dropped, which is the same bug class as the issue; it also keeps the `append(cfg.Path, ...)` aliasing hazard and does not prevent duplicate config-generation nodes for unclaimed keyed targets.

Fixes the reported root-module case, but parent-over-child override still works per ConfigResource, so a parent block silently drops child-module blocks that target other instances; it also leaves duplicate unclaimed import nodes (possible panic) and the cfg.Path append aliasing unaddressed, and it fails 2 of 3 hidden tests.

This correctly moves parent-over-child precedence from config-resource level to resource-instance level in `expandResourceImports`, and handles the knock-on effects: one config-generation node per unclaimed resource, non-aliasing module paths, and deterministic child order; tests cover for_each, count, mixed for_each/single blocks, modules, per-instance override and the missing-config path.

Returns every import block and moves parent-over-child precedence to instance level in expandResourceImports; it also dedups unclaimed config-generation nodes and fixes the slice-aliasing hazard, with thorough unit and plan tests, though the deterministic child ordering and changelog go slightly beyond the minimal fix.
